newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Can completes European acquisition.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Can completes European acquisition.

text.p: U.S. Can Corp said Wednesday it completed a previously announced agreement to buy four European aerosol manufacturing plants, one support facility and the aerosol can lines of a sixth, from Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc.
The combined operations had sales of $121 million in 1995.

The $52.8 million financing for the transaction came from U.S. Can's bank group. The company said it intends to arrange, privately, for longer term debt to repay loans used to finance its 1996 acquisitions, with any remaining available for general corporate purposes.
